title: Granular swing-promote controller with entropy-aware fallback and canary retraction hooks
author: Aisha Khan
release_notes: Adds a new swing-promote rollout controller that incrementally shifts traffic between variants using short 'swing windows' governed by entropy-aware fallbacks; includes canary retraction hooks and observability for per-cohort SLOs. Not a breaking change. See notes for rollout defaults and recommended SLO thresholds.
description: Context: We need finer-grained promotion semantics for multi-arm experiments and canaries where brief swings of traffic expose regressions without committing a long-running promotion. This PR introduces the "swing-promote" controller: it performs short, reversible 'swing windows' that shift a configurable fraction of traffic toward a candidate variant for a brief evaluation period and then either commit, retract, or iterate based on signal quality. Motivation: reduce blast radius for noisy signals while enabling fast A/B contrast checks and session-consistent promotions. Design summary: swing windows are bounded by time and sample entropy; if model output entropy suddenly spikes beyond threshold or metric variance increases, the controller triggers an immediate entropy-aware fallback which retracts the swing and, when configured, escalates to shadow capture for replay. Canaries attach retraction hooks to ensure stateful models flush KV caches before rollback. This change includes policy-as-data for swing parameters, per-cohort SLO gating, and a lightweight simulator used in CI to validate decision boundaries. Implementation highlights: 1) services/orchestrator/controller/swing_promote_controller.go implements the finite-state machine for swing lifecycle and integrates with the existing rollout runtime; 2) pkg/telemetry/probes/entropy_probe.go calculates rolling output-entropy histograms; 3) control plane API updated (api/v1/rollouts.proto) to accept swingWindow and entropyFallback config fields; 4) rollout-console UI adds lightweight progress and entropy charts; 5) e2e tests and a simulator harness added under test/rollout/swing_simulator. Checklist: - [x] Controller FSM implemented and unit-tested - [x] Telemetry probe and aggregated metrics - [x] API proto + schema migration script - [x] Console UI bits behind feature flag - [x] Backwards-compatible defaults and migration guide - [x] Integration tests + simulator runs - [x] Docs doc describing recommended SLO thresholds and example policies Rollout plan: gate behind feature flag by default, enable in staging for 2 weeks with synthetic traffic, then A/B enable for 5% of sessions with telemetry alarms; full rollout after SLO-stable window and postmortem review. Risks and mitigations: noisy entropy signals can cause oscillation so we add hysteresis and minimum window dwell time; stateful model rollbacks include KV cache flush and session-affinity drain to avoid cross-contamination. Related: ENG-8242 (rollout policy schema), ENG-8299 (telemetry aggregation improvements).
